scope: Independent acceptance and adversarial test plan for the frozen SOURCE-CAPTURE-R1 public operations. No product source or lane tests were edited.

current_helper_bindings.purpose: create-only canonical plan/request/payload staging and idempotent byte checks
complete .raw/captured sibling inventory, selected digest bytes and all-exits directory lineage
inspect the real pinned generic capture transaction for create disposition
bind externally supplied result and before/after descriptors without applying or synthesizing
verify the actual pinned source ID for the captured .md path and digest
stage and inspect the distinct source-ledger registration publication

isolated_fixture.root: fresh temporary checkout with a .work component; no repository seed/catalog mutation
isolated_fixture.lightweight_workspace: validated workspace containing exactly papers/<light_paper_id>/source.md and source.json
isolated_fixture.source_bytes: small UTF-8 Markdown with non-ASCII text and exact trailing bytes retained
isolated_fixture.source_json: valid lightweight metadata with page anchors/spans/hashes and the declared title
isolated_fixture.distinct_operation_assertion: admission batch/operation IDs must never equal or replace the capture IDs
isolated_fixture.vault: isolated fixture Vault initialized with the pinned vendor helper when a receipt-backed chain is required
isolated_fixture.external_approval: explicit test fixture supplied by the test; the implementation must never generate or default it
isolated_fixture.snapshots: byte/stat/inventory snapshots for source inputs, .work batch, Vault, catalog/index and private notes before every mutating candidate operation

plan.action: plan with valid workspace, light paper ID, batch ID and optional canonical/version declaration
plan.expected: exit 0; awaiting_external_approval; canonical plan in .work/<batch>/markdown-source/plan.json; source observation bound; no payload, Vault, index or PDF read
plan.postcondition: repeat with identical source bytes and declaration returns exact same bytes; no overwrite

plan.action: change source.md or source.json after plan; retry or continue prepare
plan.expected: MARKDOWN_SOURCE_STALE; prior plan remains byte-identical; no new authority

plan.action: missing/duplicate page anchor, wrong span/hash, stale metadata hash, page 0, >300 pages, no usable text, NUL or invalid UTF-8
plan.expected: MARKDOWN_SOURCE_INVALID or MARKDOWN_SOURCE_STALE; refusal occurs before any generated file or external write

plan.action: source.md > 8 MiB, source.json > 1 MiB, field/string over bound, invalid batch/paper IDs or invalid version label
plan.expected: closed refusal with stable code; no traceback and no partial success envelope

plan.action: workspace root traversal, symlinked workspace/ancestor, hardlink or special source file, path that becomes unsafe before normalization
plan.expected: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE or WORK_PATH_ESCAPE; no outside read/write

prepare.action: prepare a valid plan without approval-ref
prepare.expected: MARKDOWN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; no payload, request or authority

prepare.action: tamper approval plan_sha256, batch_id, paper_id, markdown_sha256, unknown field, wrong schema or legacy approval-ref
prepare.expected: MARKDOWN_APPROVAL_MISMATCH or MARKDOWN_PLAN_INVALID; no output overwrite
exit 0; exact markdown-source/<digest>.md and request.json; request binds canonical plan/ref bytes and fixed payload slot; awaiting_capture_inspect

prepare.action: repeat exact prepare, then retry same batch with changed approval or source bytes
prepare.expected: same exact bytes are reused; changed bytes produce MARKDOWN_CAPTURE_CONFLICT or MARKDOWN_REQUEST_MISMATCH and preserve the first files

prepare.action: rename/replace markdown-source directory, plan, request or payload during source re-read, validation, staging and exception cleanup
prepare.expected: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE wins over a child parser/approval error; every named ancestor and expected byte is rechecked on success and exception paths

prepare.action: inject unknown entries, unexpected empty directories, alternate payload extension or request without exact payload
prepare.expected: MARKDOWN_REQUEST_MISMATCH or WORK_PATH_UNSAFE; no success authority and no deletion of competing files

inspect.action: inspect prepared request when .raw/captured/<digest>.md is absent
inspect.expected: exit 0; disposition=create; stored_path exact .raw/captured/<digest>.md; generic transaction staging and pinned upstream authority bind capture-op; status awaiting_operator_capture; no apply, receipt, source registration or Vault mutation

inspect.action: inspect same prepared request after exact .raw/captured/<digest>.md exists
inspect.expected: exit 0; disposition=reuse; source_id verifies; transaction_staging and upstream_authority are null; no applied operation ID, receipt or registration is invented

inspect.action: plant same digest as .pdf, .txt, second .md, or multiple matching siblings
inspect.expected: MARKDOWN_CAPTURE_CONFLICT or captured-snapshot refusal; never silently select an extension or treat multiple files as reuse

inspect.action: captured .md bytes differ, mode/path is unsafe, symlink/hardlink/FIFO exists, or captured directory contains unknown entries
inspect.expected: MARKDOWN_CAPTURE_CONFLICT or WORK_PATH_UNSAFE; no authority that claims current bytes

inspect.action: invalid operation ID, wrong request slot, wrong payload digest/path, changed plan/ref hash, cross-batch request or legacy/PDF/code authority
inspect.expected: MARKDOWN_REQUEST_MISMATCH, MARKDOWN_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH, WORK_PATH_UNSAFE or schema refusal; exact error precedence documented and stable

inspect.action: replace batch, markdown-source, request, payload, Vault/raw or captured directory after a child parser/adapter error and after a success path
inspect.expected: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE on both paths, even when replacement bytes are identical; foreign replacements are never removed

inspect.action: snapshot Vault, source ledger, catalog/index and user notes before/after create and reuse inspection
inspect.expected: byte/stat/inventory exact equality; only .work inspection artifacts may be created

bind_result.action: bind authority create with actual generic capture result and before/after descriptors
bind_result.expected: operation-result-authority.v1 binds exact inspected transaction, capture-op, .md path, digest, size, mode and actual after state; no apply or Vault mutation

bind_result.action: bind a reuse authority or authority with null child transaction
bind_result.expected: closed refusal; reuse does not manufacture an operation-result authority

bind_result.action: wrong operation/batch, business path, digest, size, mode, expected old hash, before/after inventory, extra write/read/input path or runtime result attachment
bind_result.expected: stable result/authority mismatch; no output claiming capture execution

bind_result.action: replace authority/result/before/after named ancestor during validation and then raise a child error
bind_result.expected: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE takes precedence; competing files remain untouched

admit.action: admit against missing or non-receipt-backed canonical chain
admit.expected: RECEIPT_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED with genesis/bootstrap next action; no publication staging and no source record claim

admit.action: manually place exact .raw/captured/<digest>.md without matching bound capture result
admit.expected: capture authority/result refusal; raw bytes are not proven capture and cannot be registered

admit.action: admit create authority with matching result and current exact .md bytes
admit.expected: source_registration_prepared; distinct admission batch/operation IDs; standard source-ledger publication request staged; awaiting_operator_publication; published=false and receipt_backed=false; no apply

admit.action: admit reuse authority citing prior exact-content capture proof
admit.expected: same source bytes may be registered through a new admission publication; reuse does not invent a capture transaction or receipt

admit.action: wrong capture result path/hash/size/mode/operation, changed after file, missing runtime binding or unrelated business write
admit.expected: MARKDOWN_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH or MARKDOWN_SOURCE_CONFLICT; no publication request

admit.action: exact source ID/path/hash is already receipt-claimed in the current audited ledger
admit.expected: source_already_registered with no staged mutation; unrelated or incompatible rows refuse

admit.action: verify pinned source ID and source record fields
admit.expected: source ID is computed/verified for exact .md path and digest; title comes from bound observation; ingested_at is valid canonical UTC; no PDF read or version/claim authority

admit.action: replace source-ledger snapshot, raw path, Vault ancestors or staged publication inputs during success and exception paths
admit.expected: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE or source conflict; no real Vault/catalog/index/user-note mutation and no foreign replacement cleanup

cli_boundary_matrix: Unknown formal-source command, missing required option, duplicate option, extra positional argument and invalid enum return exit 2 with one structured refusal envelope.
Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, invalid UTF-8, recursive/deep JSON, missing file, directory-as-file and over-limit input return stable refusal without traceback.
Batch, operation, paper, event and path values reject empty strings, whitespace/newlines, traversal, slash/backslash, unsupported Unicode and suffix ambiguity before normalization.
Legacy PDF/code commands, legacy approval-ref, ingest-plan, paper-record, Docling and cross-kind authority objects are rejected; no fallback adapter is selected.
Staged conflicts return exit 75; ordinary malformed or boundary refusals return exit 2; no refusal prints success or future-applied language.
Success output uses the established JSON envelope, names exact paths/hashes and preserves published=false/receipt_backed=false for pending admission.
invariants_after_every_case: No operation calls vpwiki-admin, network, model runtime or PDF submission; only the pinned vendor helper is allowed in isolated fixture setup/application probes.
No files outside the approved temporary checkout .work boundary are created or changed.
Prior valid bytes and competing files remain byte-identical after refusal or conflict.
No capture operation creates a canonical source claim, source-ledger receipt, approval-ref or applied transaction receipt.
Admission IDs and nested publication IDs are distinct from capture IDs and bind the new admission request exactly.
All named ancestors, descriptors, complete sets, hashes and retained directory lineages are rechecked on success and exception paths.
minimum_acceptance_commands: focused unit/contract tests for markdown_source_contracts, markdown_source_io and markdown_source
focused research CLI tests for formal-source plan/prepare/inspect/bind-result/admit
focused security tests for path, symlink, hardlink, special-file, replacement and lineage races
isolated upstream fixture tests for create, apply evidence binding, reuse and source-ledger registration
installed-wheel resource check for five new schemas and preservation of existing schema bytes
zero-egress/import-closure check and full source/Vault/catalog/index before-after inventory check
review_limitations: The plan does not assert implementation function names beyond existing helper bindings; exact new module signatures must be checked against the candidate handoff.
No probe was executed because the new Markdown implementation is not present in the frozen terminal-1 source yet.
No test result, candidate hash, CI run or Architect acceptance is implied by this plan.
